title: Test cases and scenarios: precondition, step, expected result

videos.script: A test plan says what to test. It does not say how. {{plan}} That is the job of a test case. A case says what must be true before you start, what you do, step by step, and what should happen. {{anatomy}} The last part is the one people skip. Without an expected result, a case is a list of clicks. Anybody can follow it, and nobody can say whether it passed. {{expected}} In this lesson you write the first cases for boxoffice. Signing up, confirming the account from its e-mail, and booking tickets. {{cases}} You run them against version 1.0, and you write down what happened. {{run}} And every case gets an id, and names the requirement it checks. {{trace}} That small habit answers two questions later on. Which requirements has nobody tested? And when a requirement changes, which cases change with it? {{matrix}}
